mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(at.article_id) AS articleCount FROM blog_tag t LEFT JOIN blog_article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id LEFT JOIN blog_article a ON at.article_id = a.id AND a.status = 1 AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY articleCount DESC
SELECT t.id, t.name FROM blog_tag t INNER JOIN blog_article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id WHERE at.article_id = #{articleId}
